analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price (KRW 67,170) vs SMA5 (KRW 71,745) / SMA20 (KRW 98,486) / SMA50 (KRW 102,190): Below short-term and mid-term trends, in a weak zone.
· Position relative to SMA100 (KRW 133,837) / SMA200 (KRW 111,888): Below long-term trends, maintaining strong weakness.
· 52-week position (14.0%) + Current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (30.4→27.1): Staying in oversold territory, maintaining downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-2542.3662→-4275.3736): Worsening continuously, confirming bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band KRW 63,589): Approaching lower band, band width at 70.87% indicating increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (KRW 66,180): Approaching current price, testing support.
· Swing Resistance (KRW 80,380): Distant from current price, breakthrough would signal trend reversal.
· 5-day / 20-day High/Low Pattern (Sideways): 5-day low KRW 64,920, 20-day low KRW 64,920, 5-day high KRW 86,295, 20-day high KRW 120,080. Confirmed sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.86): Below average volume, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): Potential for further decline, meeting conditions for a wait-and-see approach.
